content: Complete the missing proof bodies in BOTH ClientA.dfy and ClientB.dfy. Return one JSON object with exactly two keys, "ClientA.dfy" and "ClientB.dfy", whose values are the complete source text of those files. Prefer JSON only; a single JSON object surrounded by prose or Markdown fences is also accepted. Never return multiple candidate objects. Preserve every byte outside the two lemma bodies, including includes, imports, export selections, parameters, preconditions and postconditions. Facts.dfy and All.dfy are immutable. Each proof body may contain only qualified calls F.Lemma(arguments); separated by whitespace. Arguments may use the existing parameters s, t, u, k, integer literals, commas, parentheses, addition, subtraction, and the expressions F.Step(...) and F.Pair(...). Do not add comments, assumptions, assertions, reveals, attributes, declarations or other statements. Use the available exported contracts to establish the target postconditions. Both clients must verify together with the complete repository.
